config.cellReusePolicy: each cell may appear in at most one swap
config.sequenceDirectionPolicy: canonical sorted disjoint pairs collapse forward and backward descriptions
config.standardAggregatePolicy: reject direct row/column/transpose layout aggregates before asymmetric type counting

rules.sourceDeduplication: Source boards are scanned as supplied; exact and symmetry reduction can be run later.
rules.disjointCells: A candidate sequence is a matching over the 81 cells; one cell cannot be changed twice.
rules.reverseSequence: The canonical pair list represents both directions of the same sequence.
rules.standardAggregates: Pure row, column, stack/band, side-swap, and transpose aggregates are rejected as asymmetric types.
